recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一顆大型未成熟巨核細胞，核單一、未分葉，胞質嗜鹼性偏藍並在邊緣有細顆粒與胞質出芽（cytoplasmic budding）；ITP 骨髓常見此類年輕巨核細胞增加，反映周邊破壞下的代償性增生。
features: Large megakaryocyte with a single large, non-lobated to minimally lobated oval nucleus
Nucleus with coarse, open chromatin, eccentrically placed
Moderate lilac-blue cytoplasm with fine granularity and irregular peripheral cytoplasmic budding
No overt platelet shedding or separated nuclear lobes
Background of maturing neutrophils, erythroid precursors, lymphocytes and red cells; slide text label describes the finding
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large immature megakaryocyte with a single, minimally lobated nucleus and moderate basophilic, finely granular cytoplasm with peripheral budding, surrounded by unremarkable maturing granulocytic and erythroid precursors. The embedded slide caption notes that young megakaryocytes are increased in number. In the setting of isolated thrombocytopenia, increased numbers of megakaryocytes including immature forms are consistent with compensatory megakaryopoiesis in immune thrombocytopenia, although this finding is not specific.

ddx.vs: Del(5q) megakaryocytes are small-to-medium with non-lobated round nuclei and mature cytoplasm, accompanied by dysplasia in other lineages and clonal cytogenetics.
Smaller blasts with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and cytoplasmic blebs, present in increased numbers with CD41/CD61 positivity.
Cohesive clusters with nuclear atypia and nucleoli, lacking megakaryocytic granular cytoplasm.
